answer: The whisper assignment is published and harbor records each panel. Shards are assigned from the bridge graph, thus cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The grading quorum of 9 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an farming party cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 2050 identities would post 2613 proofs and burn roughly 77 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
